description: Register an app (Mastodon, Lemmy, GoToSocial or any OpenID Connect client) to sign people in through this server (ADR-005). PDS admin only.

main.description: Register an OpenID Connect client. With `preset` and `appUrl` the redirect URI and scopes are filled in and the app's configuration is returned. The secret is returned only here.

name.description: Name shown on the sign-in page, e.g. the instance's name.

preset.description: App kind: fills in the redirect URI and scopes and returns its configuration.

appUrl.description: The app's public address (https), required with a preset other than generic.

redirectUris.description: Exact redirect URIs. Required without a preset; added to the preset's.

scopes.description: openid, profile, email. Default: the preset's, or openid profile.

communityDid.description: Only members of this community can sign in to the app.

clientId.description: Client ID to use (2–63 lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Default: made from the name.

clientSecret.description: The client secret. Shown once: store it in the app's configuration.

configuration.description: Ready-to-paste configuration for the preset, with the secret filled in.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: A client with that ID already exists.

name.description: Name shown on the sign-in page.

redirectUris.description: Exact redirect URIs the app may use.

scopes.description: Scopes the app may receive: openid, profile, email.

communityDid.description: When set, only members of this community can sign in to the app.

preset.description: mastodon, lemmy, gotosocial or generic, when the app was set up from a preset.

appUrl.description: The app's address, when set up from a preset.

createdBy.description: DID of the admin who registered the app.
